Historically, layoff spikes of this magnitude in Tech/AI concentrated in a single 24-hour window have preceded 2-4 week underperformance in AI software names in 5 of the last 7 comparable episodes, though the signal is confounded when layoffs coincide with earnings season restructuring announcements.
